statement: Magpie's catalog as fixed in its source (presets, their models.dev catalogs and own lists, the Claude and Google accounts), reduced to provider, model and the efforts Magpie offers; built by audit/magpie_catalog.py, nothing of an install is kept

gate.statement: a (provider, model) pair is gated when the model's maker (`maker`: the models.dev canonical_model_id namespace) is the provider's maker (`makers`, declared with its Magpie source line in audit/magpie-makers.json); every other pair is a report (owner 2026-11-18: only first-party is gated; per pair, review 2026-11-19)
